verdict.rationale: Drata's own API overview lists Risk Registers, Risks, a Risk Library and Risk Notes, and it has a 'List Risks' endpoint and a 'Drata Risk Assessment' help article, so a first-party risk register exists. The evidence is mostly titles and endpoint names, though, so the depth of the register is unproven. missing for 10: risk scoring methodology, treatment plans, risk owners, review cycles, documented risk-to-control linkage, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, a real risk register lives in the platform — scored risks, treatment plans, owners, and review cycles tied back to controls
